name: The Noor Project
mission: The Noor Project works towards overcoming poverty, illness, and illiteracy with both short and long-term approaches. Our mission is rooted in self-sufficiency, empowering poverty-stricken communities with tools and resources including education, mindset training, and employment.
theoryOfChange: We aim at the root causes of poverty among families in Pakistan to stop the cycle from repeating. We enroll families into programs that meet their needs. Once their member graduates from our vocational course and secures employment, the family is taken off the list for the ration packets and the empty spot is given to another family in need.

strengths_deep_dive: The Noor Project operates a comprehensive direct service network in Pakistan encompassing education, healthcare, and job training. By running the Noor Grammar School and free medical clinics, the organization directly intervenes to lift families out of poverty. Its low cost structure allows it to impact a substantial number of individuals relative to its overall budget of <cite id="3">$1,759,964 reported in 2023</cite>.

For Muslim donors, the charity provides explicit support for zakat compliance. The organization accepts zakat across multiple recognized distribution categories, supported by <cite id="4">an online zakat calculator</cite> that facilitates accurate donor contributions.
rich_narrative.summary: The Noor Project provides direct education, medical care, and vocational training to impoverished families in Pakistan. The organization reported <cite id="3">$1,759,964 in total revenue</cite> in its fiscal year 2023 filing. No financial filings newer than FY2023 are available — donors should treat this 3-year-old financial picture with caution. Across its operations, the group achieves an impressive reach, serving hundreds of thousands of beneficiaries at a low cost of $3.48 per beneficiary. The organization operates the Noor Grammar School, a health clinic, a food bank, and technical training programs designed to foster long-term self-sufficiency. Its direct service model ensures that assistance reaches marginalized populations directly. The organization is <cite id="2">zakat-eligible</cite> and maintains <cite id="4">a zakat calculator</cite> to assist Muslim donors in fulfilling their religious obligations.
